system:
You are evaluating draft replies from an automated customer-support agent for Spotify's Twitter support account, as it operated in 2017.

Score the CANDIDATE REPLY on five criteria, each an integer 1-5.

correctness - Is what it says actually true for Spotify, and does it address what the customer asked?
  1 = wrong or answers a different question   3 = partially right, or vague but not wrong
  5 = accurate and on-point

groundedness - Is every claim supported by the PRECEDENTS shown?
  1 = main claims appear nowhere in the precedents   3 = loosely related to them
  5 = every factual claim traceable to a precedent

consistency - Does it handle this the way the precedents show Spotify handled similar cases (same action, same level of caution, same register)?
  1 = contradicts how Spotify handled these   3 = plausible but diverges
  5 = matches the precedents' approach

helpfulness - Does it move the customer forward?
  1 = useless or pure deflection   3 = generic but usable
  5 = a clear next step or a real answer

no_unsupported_claims - Does it avoid inventing policies, prices, timeframes, or promising account actions (refunds, resets, unlocks) the agent cannot perform?
  1 = makes a promise or states a policy with no support   3 = borderline hedged claim
  5 = makes no unsupported claim at all

Judge only the reply in front of you. The REFERENCE REPLY is what Spotify actually sent; it is context, not a target - a different but equally good reply should score well, and copying the reference does not automatically score 5.

Return ONLY JSON:
{"correctness": n, "groundedness": n, "consistency": n, "helpfulness": n, "no_unsupported_claims": n, "rationale": "<one sentence>"}
prompt:

Hey you guys! I having trouble making a payment in your website. Error message reason changes everytime and its gtting frustrating. Im a new subscriber btw. I jst want to make a payment with my Prepaid number.

PRECEDENTS:

[2792135] past customer: why does your website keep timing out? Trying to update my billing info so you can get paid.
     spotify replied: Hey there! Are you getting any error messages? If so, can you send us a screenshot? We'll take a closer look

[2369702] past customer: Hey - why do you make updating payment methods so hard and also why don't you have a phone number? I just want to give you my money thanks
     spotify replied: 1: Hey Savannah! We don't have telephone support right now, but we can continue helping out here on Twitter.

[1336498] past customer: I need help y'all won't accept my payment and yes I've went through the troubleshoot. My card works fine everywhere
     spotify replied: Hi Caden, help's here. Just to check, are you getting an error message when you subscribe to Premium? A screenshot of it will be handy

[2637140] past customer: hey my payment isnt working can you have someone dm me or email me? __email__
     spotify replied: Hi, help's here! We can continue helping you on Twitter if you'd like. Or, you can fill out our contact form at <link> We'll reach out to you via email. To get started, could you fire over your email address & username? We'll take a look under the hood

[2794530] past customer: Your website is down! Fix it pls!
     spotify replied: Hi there! Everything should be running smoothly now. Let us know if this is still happening

CANDIDATE REPLY (score this):
Hey there! Are you getting any error messages? If so, can you send us a screenshot? We'll take a closer look

REFERENCE REPLY actually sent by Spotify (context only):
Hey there! Could you send us a screenshot of the issue you're having? We'll see what we can suggest

Return the JSON scores.
text: {"correctness":4,"groundedness":5,"consistency":5,"helpfulness":4,"no_unsupported_claims":5,"rationale":"The reply closely matches Spotify's established troubleshooting response and requests a screenshot, though it does not directly address whether prepaid payments are supported."}
